source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
A unit with 1 or more models carrying a **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapon may use [Close-Quarters Shooting](vsdata:core-rule/close-quarters-shooting) (rule 10.06).

Under any other shooting type, each model that is not a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** shoots with 1 or more weapons from one set only:

- its **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapons
- its ranged weapons without **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]**

The printed **[[PISTOL]](vsdata:weapon-ability/pistol)** entry (24.27) makes **[[PISTOL]](vsdata:weapon-ability/pistol)** the same ability as **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]**.

mode.monsterVehicle: hit roll -1 unless a [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapon targets a unit engaged with the firing unit
mode.otherModels: only [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons, only against units engaged with their unit
